spans.s: (a-nirbaddha) adj. (sound) not restrained or regulated (i. e. either too high or too low) अनिर्बद्धं तूच्चावचम्
(anirbandhagāmi-tva) n. the state of being that which comes without restriction (लाभः) सामवायिकानामनिर्बन्धगामि- त्वात् पुरोगः ArthŚā. iii. 70. 3 (9. 4)
(a-nirbandhapūrvakam) adv. without any insi- stence or compulsion भृतकाध्यापनस्य निषेधादाह। अर्पणेति। अनिर्बन्धपूर्वकं यथा तथेत्यर्थः BālamBha. i. 150. 22 (on 1. 28)
(a-nirbandharuṣ) adj. not having persistent anger, not inexorable in anger प्रह्वेष्वनिर्बन्धरुषो हि सन्तः
(a-nirbandhaviṣaya) m. not a domain of insist- ence अयमनिर्बन्धविषयो राशिः Āśca
